title: Research: nilpotent couplings do not save shallow GL3 calls
body:
## Result

This is a scoped exact negative result in a two-dirty-role formal model. Over `F2[GL3(F2)]`, expanding the six idempotent rank-one couplings to all nine nonzero rank-one couplings (including the three nilpotents) does not lower the direct call count for any ordered pair of targets whose individual coordinate-CNOT distance is at most two.

For all 961 pairs, the exact minimum in the stated domain equals `d(p)+d(q) <= 4`. The complete 54-factor alphabet was searched through length three, the full strict-saving boundary. The certificate records 160,435 raw words, 89,358 distinct depth-three transfer states (91,708 across depths zero through three), and 126,900 transitions. Every transfer coefficient is compared over all 168 group elements. An independently implemented set-based replay checks the same endpoint domain and all direct witnesses.

## Cost and scope

Each rank-one conditional factor costs one call. The two roles are arbitrary dirty outputs; there is no helper, clean state, inter-call frame change, copy, or restoration operation. The involution identity is exact for all nine couplings because each CNOT label is an involution and characteristic two gives `([g]+[e])^2=0`.

This is a finite primitive-model result. It does not establish a native supplier for nilpotent couplings, a supplier mapping, a multiplier construction, or a new `kappa`. It covers only two roles and CNOT radius at most two per output.

## Reproduction

From the repository root:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/gl3-nilpotent-coupling-seeda9ab7bd2/search.py --check
python3 -I -B research/gl3-nilpotent-coupling-seeda9ab7bd2/verify.py
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/gl3-nilpotent-coupling-seeda9ab7bd2 --check-only
```

Expected search and independent replay outputs are recorded in `README.md`; exact recurrence and evidence are in `PROOF.md` and `CERTIFICATE.json`. The search and independent verifier passed locally under CPython 3.14.7, including optimized mode; the package metadata check and `git diff --check` passed. The generic package runner requires Python 3.12, which is unavailable locally; hosted CI is pending.

The required selected-record baseline command was attempted but the sparse checkout lacks `research/complex-sw4-frame8`, so it stops with `Invalid package root`. The selected supplier's cold replay was not run because this finite experiment does not alter that supplier. Its selected-record hash, review, source manifest, assembly certificate, and reproduction instructions are pinned in `TASK.md` and `SOURCES.json`.
